payload.title: LERM Applied to ice cores
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook applies the Linear Empirical Response Model (LERM) to ice core data over the Holocene, aiming to recreate Figure 5 from a referenced publication. The analysis is similar to previous figures but uses different parameters. The notebook involves data loading, transition detection, and visualization using various scientific libraries.
goals: Recreate Figure 5 from the original publication using LERM on ice core data.
Apply LERM to analyze ice cores over the Holocene.
Visualize the results with appropriate parameters.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on applying the Linear Empirical Response Model to ice core data, aiming to recreate a specific figure from a publication. It involves data loading using pyLiPD, transition detection, and visualization with matplotlib and seaborn.
section_blurbs.heading: LERM Applied to ice cores

inputs: Ice core data over the Holocene
outputs: Recreated Figure 5 from the original publication
